title: Affine etale ring maps are weakly etale
statement: Let $R\to C$ be a homomorphism of commutative rings which is finitely presented as an $R$-algebra [def-weil-pbc-finitely-presented-algebra] and such that for every $R$-algebra $D$ and square-zero ideal $J\subseteq D$, reduction gives a bijection $\operatorname{Hom}_{R\text{-alg}}(C,D)\to\operatorname{Hom}_{R\text{-alg}}(C,D/J)$. Then $C$ is flat over $R$ [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map], and the multiplication map $C\otimes_R C\to C$ is flat.

Algebra.WeaklyEtale.instOfEtale (Weakly.lean:55-60) then supplies WeaklyEtale R C. Its projections Algebra.WeaklyEtale.flat (Weakly.lean:38) and Algebra.WeaklyEtale.flat_lmul' (Weakly.lean:39) are precisely Module.Flat R C and flatness of multiplication C tensor_R C -> C. The multiplication is Algebra.TensorProduct.lmul' R, not the structure map from either factor. No Noetherian, nonzero-ring, field or finiteness hypothesis beyond finite presentation is required.
